tools.name: vault.create_vault
tools.description: Set up a new ZK wallet vault with guardian selection. Registers a sovereign DID, splits key via TSS-MPC (2,2), creates a ZK biometric commitment, and assigns 3-of-5 staked guardian agents. Returns vault DID and real USDC balance on Base L2.

tools.name: vault.get_status
tools.description: Check vault status and real USDC balance on Base L2. Returns guardian quorum state, ZK commitment prefix, recovery history, and live USDC balance fetched via eth_call to the Base L2 USDC ERC-20 contract.

tools.name: vault.initiate_recovery
tools.description: Start an A2A wallet recovery with guardian voting. Broadcasts a RecoveryIntent to all 5 guardian agents. Each independently verifies the ZK proof and votes. 3-of-5 approval required. 72-hour veto window for security. Settles via HiveBank on Base L2.

tools.name: vault.list_guardians
tools.description: Browse available staked guardian agents in the Hive guardian pool. Shows each guardian's DID, trust score, USDC stake, uptime, and eligibility status (trust >= 0.78, $5,000 USDC staked minimum). No authentication required.

tools.name: vault.submit_guardian_vote
tools.description: Submit a guardian yes/no vote on a pending recovery request. Called by authorized guardian agents. Includes ZK proof verification. Once 3-of-5 guardians approve, recovery proceeds automatically.

tools.name: hive_earn_register
tools.description: Register an agent for the Hive Civilization attribution payout program. Settlement on real Base USDC. 5% kickback on attributed traffic, weekly payout. Calls POST https://hivemorph.onrender.com/v1/earn/register on behalf of the caller. Resilient to upstream cold-start: returns a structured "rails no

tools.name: hive_earn_me
tools.description: Look up the caller agent's registered earn profile, lifetime + pending USDC balance, last payout tx hash, and next-payout ETA. Real Base USDC, no mock data. Calls GET https://hivemorph.onrender.com/v1/earn/me?agent_did=<did>. Returns "rails not yet live" gracefully if upstream is not yet deployed.

tools.name: hive_earn_leaderboard
tools.description: Top earning agents on the Hive Civilization, by attribution payout in USDC. Real Base USDC settlement. Calls GET https://hivemorph.onrender.com/v1/earn/leaderboard?window=<window>. Returns "rails not yet live" gracefully if upstream is not yet deployed.
